method: pyarrow direct read of split_line_item_split_cost, grouped by resource_tags['aws_eks_workload_name'] (normalized to app prefix) where line_item_product_code=AmazonEKS and resource_id contains ':pod/'. unused_ekslevel is split_line_item_unused_cost summed across ALL namespaces on every EKS-managed node in the window (core-on-demand + apps-serving + database-on-demand), not just this project's own pods.
caveat: this is the EKS split-cost-allocation slice only (per-pod share of AmazonEC2/AmazonEKS vCPU+GB instance-hours). It does not include NAT, EBS/gp3 volumes, load balancer, or other non-instance-hour lines -- not directly comparable to the full $/run figures in the Matrix.
